msg: CentOS Linux 7 image: CentOS Linux 7 reached end of life on June 30, 2024. No security updates, and its yum repos are gone from the mirrors.
fix: FROM almalinux:9 (or almalinux:8 for an EL8 target). AlmaLinux 9 is supported until 2032.

msg: CentOS Linux 8 image (centos:latest and a bare FROM centos also resolve to 8): CentOS Linux 8 reached end of life on December 31, 2021.
fix: FROM almalinux:8 keeps the EL8 package set; AlmaLinux 8 is supported until 2029.

msg: CentOS Stream 8 image: CentOS Stream 8 reached end of life on May 31, 2024.
fix: Use almalinux:8 (same EL8 ABI, supported until 2029) or almalinux:9.

msg: mirrorlist.centos.org no longer answers, so yum fails with 'Cannot find a valid baseurl' before any package installs.
fix: Point the repo at AlmaLinux: mirrorlist=https://mirrors.almalinux.org/mirrorlist/$releasever/baseos (install almalinux-release instead of editing by hand).

msg: mirror.centos.org path for CentOS 7/8: after end of life the content was removed from the mirrors and moved to vault.centos.org.
fix: Replace the .repo with AlmaLinux's (repo.almalinux.org/almalinux/$releasever/BaseOS/$basearch/os/).

msg: vault.centos.org is a frozen archive: the build works again, but nothing in it gets a security fix after the end-of-life date.
fix: Treat the vault repo as a bridge only; move the image or host to AlmaLinux 8 or 9.

msg: EPEL 7 ended with CentOS 7 and was moved to the Fedora archive; the epel-release-latest-7 URL no longer gives updates.
fix: dnf install epel-release on AlmaLinux (EPEL 8/9), after enabling powertools (EL8) or crb (EL9).

msg: Software Collections (SCL, devtoolset, rh-*) exist only for EL7; there is no centos-release-scl on EL8 or EL9.
fix: Use gcc-toolset-N for compilers and dnf module streams (dnf module enable php:8.2) for language runtimes.

msg: yum-cron was removed in EL8, so the automatic update job silently stops existing.
fix: dnf install dnf-automatic && systemctl enable --now dnf-automatic.timer

msg: The ntp package (ntpd, ntpdate) was removed in EL8.
fix: Use chrony: dnf install chrony && systemctl enable --now chronyd (chronyc makestep replaces ntpdate).

msg: The legacy network service (network-scripts) is deprecated in EL8 and removed in EL9.
fix: Use NetworkManager: nmcli connection reload && nmcli connection up <name>.

msg: authconfig was removed in EL8.
fix: Use authselect (authselect select sssd with-mkhomedir).

msg: The 'docker' package came from CentOS 7 extras; EL8/9 repos do not ship it.
fix: Use podman (dnf install podman podman-docker) or add the docker-ce repo.

msg: EL7 package name: unversioned python / python-* packages do not exist on EL8/9, and EL9 ships no Python 2.
fix: Install python3, python3-pip, python3-devel (python39/python3.11 streams on EL8).

msg: Unversioned python shebang: EL8 has no /usr/bin/python by default, so the script fails with 'bad interpreter'.
fix: #!/usr/bin/python3

msg: On AlmaLinux ansible_distribution is 'AlmaLinux', so a task gated on 'CentOS' is skipped without an error.
fix: when: ansible_os_family == 'RedHat' (and ansible_distribution_major_version for 8/9).

msg: OS detection that looks for CentOS: AlmaLinux has no /etc/centos-release and /etc/os-release says ID="almalinux", so this branch never runs.
fix: Read /etc/os-release and test ID_LIKE for "rhel" plus VERSION_ID.

msg: CentOS signing key: AlmaLinux packages are signed with a different key, so gpgcheck fails on every AlmaLinux package.
fix: gpgkey=file:///etc/pki/rpm-gpg/RPM-GPG-KEY-AlmaLinux-9 (or -8).

msg: Hard-coded EL7 RPM or repo path: built against EL7 libraries (glibc 2.17, OpenSSL 1.0.2), it will not install cleanly on EL8/9.
fix: Point at the el8/el9 build of the same package, or use $releasever in the URL.

msg: Vagrant box for CentOS 7/8: the base OS is past end of life.
fix: config.vm.box = "almalinux/9" (or "almalinux/8").

msg: This path converts to Red Hat Enterprise Linux, which needs a paid subscription per server (RHEL Server Standard is US$878.90 per year on the Red Hat Store). AlmaLinux is free to run.
fix: If the subscription is not wanted, use almalinux-deploy (EL8 in place) or ELevate (CentOS 7 to AlmaLinux 8).
